boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study and academic-support environments in and around Kreitzberg Library.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library
cards.subtitle: Six floors for collections, research, and study
cards.notes: Start here when your assignment needs books, databases, scanning, or a change of study setting across the building’s six floors.
cards.short_summary: A full-service academic library with varied study infrastructure.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich describes Kreitzberg Library as offering six floors for collections, research, and study, plus wireless internet, scanners, and photocopiers.
cards.access_notes: Library access and service availability can vary by semester; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Bring collaborators and plan a shared work session here; check locally for room availability and any booking or use requirements.
cards.short_summary: A named group-work option inside the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich lists group-study rooms among the renovated Kreitzberg Library spaces and identifies a Kreitzberg Library Group Study Room.
cards.access_notes: Confirm availability and any reservation procedure with the library before relying on a room.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library Computer Labs
cards.subtitle: Network-connected computing in Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Use these labs when you need a Norwich-network computer alongside library research materials; bring files in a cloud or portable format.
cards.short_summary: Library-based computer access for coursework and research.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich states that Kreitzberg Library has computer labs with access to the Norwich University network.
cards.source_title: Library, Archives, Museum (LAM) | Norwich University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Computer availability and software access may vary; verify with library or IT staff if specialized tools are needed.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Thin-client computer access in the library
cards.notes: Choose the mezzanine when a cloud-hosted student computer is useful; sign in with your Norwich credentials and save work appropriately.
cards.short_summary: A named library level with thin-client access.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich IT lists thin clients in the Kreitzberg Library mezzanine and says student computer labs are hosted in Microsoft Azure.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students with applicable Norwich system access; confirm library hours before arrival.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Thin-client computer access near writing support
cards.notes: Set up on the second floor for a Norwich thin client, then use nearby writing support when you need feedback on a draft.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor computer option within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich IT lists thin clients on the second floor of Kreitzberg Library.
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students with applicable Norwich system access; confirm library hours before arrival.

cards.title: Norwich University Archives Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Schedule time here for primary-source work or rare books; follow reading-room rules and arrange an appointment outside posted semester hours.
cards.short_summary: A supervised space for hands-on archival research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Archives identifies its fifth-floor reading room as a space for students and researchers to use archival documents and rare books.
cards.source_title: Hours & Location | Norwich University Archives & Special Collections
cards.access_notes: Currently listed as 12–4 p.m. Monday–Friday during the semester and by appointment otherwise; all visitors may book appointments.

cards.title: Kreitzberg Library Media-Viewing Room
cards.subtitle: Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Use the media-viewing room when a class film or streaming assignment benefits from a dedicated viewing environment; ask staff about access.
cards.short_summary: A designated room for media-based coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich lists a media-viewing room among Kreitzberg Library’s facilities.
cards.access_notes: Check with library staff for current access, equipment, and any room-use requirements.

cards.title: Todd Multipurpose Room
cards.subtitle: Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Use this library multipurpose setting for scheduled academic events or collaborative work; verify that it is not reserved before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A named academic-use room inside Kreitzberg Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich lists the Todd Multipurpose Room as a Kreitzberg Library facility and recently used it for a mathematics talk and awards presentation.
cards.source_title: First annual Mathematical Showdown outreach held at Norwich
cards.access_notes: This is a multipurpose event space; availability depends on the library and scheduled programming.

cards.title: Center for Writing, Room 201
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Bring your draft and assignment materials for an in-person writing conversation; appointments are recommended, though walk-ins are welcomed if a coach is free.
cards.short_summary: Writing-focused support space with in-person coaching.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich locates the Center for Writing in Room 201 on the second floor of Kreitzberg Library and says students may stop by if a coach is available.
cards.source_title: Center for Writing Appointment Information & FAQs | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Appointments are recommended to guarantee a coach; in-person sessions take place in Room 201.

cards.entity_name: Center for Academic Success and Achievement (CASA)
cards.title: Center for Academic Success and Achievement (CASA)
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Kreitzberg Library
cards.notes: Visit CASA to build study strategies or connect with tutoring support; contact the center to match your course needs with available help.
cards.short_summary: Academic coaching and tutoring support within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich states that CASA is on the fourth floor of Kreitzberg Library and provides academic support, learning strategies, and professional and peer tutoring.
cards.access_notes: Services are for Norwich students; contact CASA to confirm current tutoring options and appointment procedures.
